artists.biography: Durand Jones & The Indications is an American contemporary R&B and soul group founded by the core songwriting trio of singer Durand Jones, singer/drummer Aaron Frazer, and guitarist Blake Rhein. Formed in 2012, the band came to prominence as part of the soul revivalist movement around the time of the reissue of their debut album in 2018. Their second album American Love Call was released in March 2019, followed by Private Space in July 2021.

Their second album American Love Call was released in March 2019, followed by Private Space in July 2021.

perplexity.description:
Durand Jones & The Indications (2016) marks the debut of the Bloomington-based soul trio, establishing their signature sound of raw, unpolished funk and deep soul. Recorded directly to tape in basement studios using a Tascam four-track machine, the album captures the group's early chemistry with soaring vocal work from Durand Jones paired with dusty drums, slinking guitars, and screaming organs. The production aesthetic emphasizes authenticity over polish, reflecting the band's gospel roots and their collaborative songwriting approach between Jones, drummer Aaron Frazer, and guitarist Blake Rhein.

The album arrived during the early stages of the contemporary soul revivalist movement, though the band would gain broader prominence following the 2018 reissue of this debut. The record's sound draws comparisons to artists like Charles Bradley and Lee Fields, positioning Durand Jones & The Indications within a lineage of contemporary soul practitioners committed to traditional funk and soul aesthetics. Despite its modest initial release, the album established the band's core identity and songwriting foundation, which would carry through their subsequent releases.

The debut has since accumulated hundreds of millions of streams and built the band a dedicated international following, though this success came without viral moments or major label backing. The album's influence on the band's later work—including American Love Call (2019) and Private Space (2021)—demonstrates its importance as the template for their evolving but consistent approach to soul and funk music.
